Guides / Catching / Poké Balls

Poké Balls

All 21 balls: effects, prices and when the Mart sells them.

Auto battles throw Poké, Great, Ultra and Master Balls, or the special ball you pick in Catch rules while you have any. In battles you fight yourself, the Catch button throws whichever ball you choose. Special balls work only when their condition is met; otherwise they catch like a Poké Ball.

BallEffectMartSold fromSells for
Poké BallThe basic ball (×1).$20Start$10
Great Ball×1.5 always.$60Bug Catcher rank$30
Ultra Ball×2 always.$150Ace Trainer rank$75
Quick Ball5× on the very first turn of a battle. Throw it before you attack.$2501 badge$125
Timer BallGets better every turn: +0.3× a turn, up to 4× after 10 turns.$2001 badge$100
Dusk Ball3× at night (7pm to 6am on your clock) or on Misty Pyre at any hour.$2001 badge$100
Net Ball3.5× against Water and Bug types.$200Start$100
Dive Ball3.5× on Sunny Shore (the water island) or against any Water type.$2001 badge$100
Nest BallBest on low-level Pokémon: 4× at Lv1, dropping to 1× at Lv30.$200Start$100
Repeat Ball3.5× on a species already in your Pokédex.$2001 badge$100
Level Ball2× if your Pokémon is a higher level, 4× at double its level, 8× at four times.$3002 badges$150
Fast Ball4× against fast Pokémon (base Speed 100 or more).$3002 badges$150
Heavy BallFor heavy Pokémon: +20 catch rate from 200kg, +30 from 300kg, but -20 under 100kg.$3002 badges$150
Moon Ball4× on Pokémon whose family evolves with a Moon Stone (Clefairy, Nidorino, Skitty, Munna…).$3003 badges$150
Love Ball8× if your Pokémon is from the same family and the opposite gender.$3003 badges$150
Dream Ball4× against a sleeping Pokémon.$5004 badges$250
Beast Ball5× on Ultra Beasts, but only 0.1× on anything else.$1,5006 badges$750
Luxury BallCatches like a Poké Ball. A comfy ball: the Pokémon inside earns 10% more EXP for good.$4002 badges$200
Heal BallCatches like a Poké Ball, and cheap. The Pokémon inside joins fully healed, ready to fight.$40Start$20
Premier BallCatches like a Poké Ball. A free gift: buy 10 balls at once and the Mart adds one.–Free gift–
Master BallNever fails.–––
  • Buy 10 balls at once and the Mart adds a free Premier Ball (one per 10).
  • The Mart buys back its own balls for half price. Auto-sell spare balls (Catch rules) sells balls you *find* above a number you keep (never below your auto-buy target, never the Master Ball).
  • A Luxury Ball's Pokémon earns 10% more EXP for good; a Heal Ball's joins fully healed.
